name: self-improving-agent
summary: OpenClaw skill that captures learnings, errors and feature requests to improve an agent across sessions.
description: A self-improvement skill for OpenClaw: it captures learnings, errors and feature requests during work so an agent keeps improving across sessions. The publishable package is a dependency-free skill folder with a SKILL.md entry point and an OpenClaw hook; it installs through OpenClaw's built-in skill installer, the ClawHub CLI (npm i -g clawhub) or by copying the skill folder into ~/.openclaw/skills/. A multi-agent version for Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot lives in the pskoett-ai-skills repo.
